description: FliY is a structural component of the Bacillus subtilis flagellar switch and a
  CheY-P phosphatase. Its N-terminal region binds CheY-P, its CheC-like catalytic region accelerates
  CheY-P hydrolysis, and its FliN-like C-terminal region contributes to the flagellar C-ring.
  FliY resets the chemotactic signal near the motor, while CheC provides a second native phosphatase
  and CheD-dependent adaptation feedback. Its contribution to flagellar assembly is distinct
  from the ion-driven torque-generating activity of the motor.
